description: This file defines the RetrievePolicy class, a final immutable command class used within a policy query framework. It provides methods to create, deserialize, and manage retrieval commands for policies based on their IDs, with JSON serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: RetrievePolicy
classes.description: A command class for retrieving a specific policy by ID, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization and equality/hash operations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a RetrievePolicy command with a given PolicyId and optional headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a RetrievePolicy object from a JSON string or JSON object, with optional headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the policy to retrieve.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path for the retrieve operation, which is empty in this case.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload data to a JSON object builder, including the policy ID.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new RetrievePolicy instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on policyId and superclass.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality check, confirms object type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on policyId and superclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object including policyId.
